summary: UI/UX batch fixes verification for Chutex Care V8 bracelet app. All 12 features tested and verified: dark mode button styling, devices page dark mode, header spacing, Dorsi Bilan BLE connect flow, direction images removal, percentage centering, round back buttons, info popup glass effect, bracelet pairing instructions, DeviceCard dark mode, and dashboard stability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI/UX fixes verified working. Key verifications: 1) Dashboard 'Voir mon activite' button has WHITE bg (#FFF) with icon in dark mode, 2) Devices page supports dark mode with black background and glass effect cards, 3) Header has 44px paddingBottom, 4) Dorsi Bilan step 1 only shows 'Connecter le coussin' button when BLE not connected (no 'Continuer sans coussin'), 5) Direction measurement steps don't show direction images (only icons), 6) Percentage is centered in measurement circle via transform: translate(-50%, -50%), 7-8) Back buttons are round (borderRadius: 999px), 9) Info popup has strong glass effect (backdrop-filter: blur(32px), background: rgba(0,0,0,0.78)), 10) Bracelet step 2 text includes '20% de charge', 'clignote vert', and 'un doigt de largeur du poignet', 11) DeviceCard has dark mode colors (rgba(255,255,255,0.06) bg), 12) Dashboard loads without crash.
